incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert: elevated error rate for text-generation path in us-east-1 — fallback routing loop suspected (auto-page to oncall).

amanda: saw the page, jumping in. getting logs now. impact looks like wrong model variant responses + spikes in 5xx from runtime.

raj: oncall here. can you confirm customer-facing impact? any specific customers affected?

amanda: initial skim — ~37k requests in the last 15m showing mismatch between requested model tag and actual model served, and many requests retried across regions. I think smart-routing policy is falling back repeatedly and cache reuse is wrong.

support-jess: we have 3 customer tickets opened reporting jittery completions and tokenization mismatch, customers: AcmeAnalytics, TradeLabs. Marked urgent.

cs-lina: notifying account teams for AcmeAnalytics & TradeLabs. estimating visible latency spikes and some incorrect outputs.

incident-bot: Paging: @raj (oncall), @sre-olivia (sre pager), severity: P1, channel: #incidents. Link: https://internal.incidents/1767123456

tomas: quick technical hypothesis — KV prefixing for request-level caching is using region + routing-policy but NOT including model_variant/model_hash. When the fallback policy substitutes a compatible-but-different model variant, the cache key collides and returns KV state (past-kv) for another variant -> wrong reuse. If routing loops, clients see repeated mismatch and higher error rates.

amanda: logs that show the cache key pattern: `kvcache:{customer}:{region}:{session_prefix}` — missing model version. example trace: `req_id=abc123 requested=gptx-8b-v2 served=gptx-8b-quant` then later `served=gptx-4b-quant` but KV reused from gptx-8b-v2.

raj: thanks. can we mitigate fast? options: 1) disable smart routing feature flag (global) 2) roll back recent routing policy change 3) flush affected KV prefix in redis (careful, per-customer).

sre-olivia: doing 1 and 2 now. flipping FF -> `smart_routing.v2.enabled = false` in prod.

sre-olivia: exec log:
```
$ curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  https://config.internal/api/flags/smart_routing.v2.enabled -d '{"value": false}'
200 OK
```

amanda: rolling out a temporary config to force model pinning on fallback: `routing.fallback.enforce_variant_pin = true` for us-east-1. will keep for 30m while we validate.

tomas: for cache flush, here's a safe targeted command (limits to affected customers and region):
```
# list keys for AcmeAnalytics only
redis-cli -h redis-prod --scan --pattern "kvcache:AcmeAnalytics:us-east-1:*" > /tmp/keys.txt
# delete
cat /tmp/keys.txt | xargs -L 100 redis-cli -h redis-prod DEL
```

sre-olivia: started deleting keys for the 2 impacted customers. monitoring memory/latency on redis.

amanda: quick check: rolling error rate down from 18% -> 4% within 6m after feature flag flip and targeted deletes. latency also normalizing.

support-jess: updated customer tickets: told them we identified a routing/cache mismatch, applied mitigations, asked for any remaining problematic requests and request ids. responses so far: AcmeAnalytics sees normal completions now.

raj: good. can we confirm no global data corruption? any other services writing to same KV prefix format?

tomas: audit shows only router and runtime wrote to `kvcache:*`. However router had a recent merge that changed keys to `kvcache:{customer}:{region}:{policy}` and we forgot to include model_variant. commit: `routingsvc@b4f9c` on 2026-02-18.

amanda: plan: 1) keep smart routing disabled for 30m, 2) enqueue a rolling fix to include model_variant in cache key (backport to 2.1 and canary), 3) perform broader scan to find stale keys and evict by safe predicates, 4) notify customers with RCA draft.

sre-olivia: status: mitigation successful, no ongoing retries, redis ops stable. setting incident status -> mitigated and will still be P1 until code fix released.

incident-bot: Handoff: @raj you are primary until 22:00 UTC, @sre-olivia secondary. Next steps: create postmortem doc in #eng-incident-postmortems and assign owners.

raj: noted. I'll take the postmortem writeup with Tomas and Amanda. Olivia please add the ops timeline and Redis commands. Jess & Lina please prepare customer-facing note.

amanda: quick follow-up: add unit+integration test to ensure KV key composition includes `model_variant` and `model_hash`. Also add a check in pre-merge CI to catch missing key components.

tomas: adding regression test in routing repo now. snippet:
```
assert build_cache_key(customer, region, policy, model_variant) == expected_key
```

sre-olivia: leaving a note to oncall rotation: if we see repeat in other regions, escalate immediately and consider temporary global disable of routing fallbacks.

support-jess: customers notified. awaiting approval for formal RCA.

cs-lina: coordinating account-level follow-ups tomorrow 14:00 PST.

raj: closing realtime ops loop. moving thread to follow-up channel for postmortem. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
